name: WI-04
label: Safe D

key_factors: Longtime incumbent Gwen Moore running for reelection
model.rationale: The baseline of D+27 aligns with the district's D+26 lean, incumbency, and Moore's fundraising edge, with no evidence pointing the other way. Prediction markets at 97% for Moore confirm Safe D status.
model.watch: A surprise scandal or major outside spending against Moore could narrow the margin, though not plausibly enough to threaten the seat.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Milwaukee-based WI-04 is one of the most Democratic districts in the country, with a partisan lean of D+26. Gwen Moore has held the seat since 2005 and is running again after easily securing renomination. She has raised over $1 million, far outpacing Republican Tim Rogers, who reports no fundraising figures and lacks name recognition or outside support.

With no public polling, the forecast rests on district fundamentals, incumbency, and money, all of which point strongly to Moore. Prediction markets give her roughly a 97% chance of winning. The expected margin is about 27 points, matching the quantitative baseline, and the race is rated Safe Democratic.
